layoutRules.gameException: fixed control positions while playing; adaptive region hidden
layoutRules.sparseAdaptiveAlignment: sole composer fills available adaptive region when no supplemental input exists; no blank spacer
layoutRules.denseAdaptiveContent: scroll within adaptive region; fixed input and top target retain their bounds
layoutRules.taskNavigation: direct visible task cards with name + semantic dot + short status, followed by new task; no list icon gate
layoutRules.adaptiveComposerSizing: supplemental tools take required space; sole composer fills remaining height; sketch retains compact composer; send stays bottom-right inside composer
layoutRules.parameterControlSelection: bounded continuous parameter: slider; finite discrete values: segmented/select; integer incremental quantity: stepper when appropriate; explicit action: button

parameterContract.invalidHex: show validation; retain lastValidValue; no color confirm action
parameterContract.undo: restore original expression and remove precise override
parameterContract.handoff: retain text, color, raw sketch, confirmed layout and attachments in sole composer; explicit send submits
parameterContract.staleResult: discard if target or revision differs
parameterContract.colorApply: every valid setColor or setHex updates draft and composer HEX immediately without submit or execution
parameterContract.colorConfirmation: valid direct edits become confirmed input values immediately; no extra completion button
parameterContract.layoutConfirmation: interpreted layout still requires explicit confirmation
parameterContract.sketchConfirmation: toolbar check inserts thumbnail into sole composer; re-edit replaces same attachment; never submits

mediaInputContract.phone: current target, editable draft, input controls and transient press feedback only
mediaInputContract.pc: execution confirmations, success, failure and account restrictions
mediaInputContract.coin: one coin on explicit click; no quantity picker or second confirmation
mediaInputContract.send: explicit inside-composer send; recording end does not send
mediaInputContract.resultPresentation: no phone result page, success card, toast or changed-to-success action label
mediaInputContract.delivery: receiver acknowledgement and idempotency remain; one-way input describes UI ownership, not transport
mediaInputContract.draft: retain until acknowledgement; preserve on failure; never automatically resend
mediaInputContract.navigation: fullscreen/list mode switch left with fullscreen icon; previous and next grouped right
mediaInputContract.brand: Bilibili pink action accent and cold-white Liquid Glass; content color remains independent
mediaInputContract.playback: explicit play/pause from authoritative player state; speed from supported rates; target-player volume and mute
mediaInputContract.controlFeedback: confirmed playback, rate and volume may drive controls; no phone result pages or success cards
mediaInputContract.volume: target player audio via continuous 0–100 slider and displayed value; speaker mutes/restores previous nonzero value; no increment/decrement buttons
mediaInputContract.prototypeSamples: 1/1.5/2x and 0/40/60/80 volume are discrete Figma examples, not validated platform enumerations

paintingInputContract.composer: Hidden in drawing/command modes. Show one synchronized text editor only for an authoritative editable focused target; finish ends editing, not a second send. Blur restores drawing.
paintingInputContract.paintSurface: Main device retains artwork. Phone is a visual secondary-hand tool/parameter controller.
paintingInputContract.range: Target-defined limits and units. 12/32 px are design samples.
paintingInputContract.photoImport: Removed from this scene. Existing system tap-to-transfer is outside this prototype.
paintingInputContract.paletteKnife: Requested design entry; native brush mapping remains unverified.

appearance.scope: GoPaint only; project-selected palette, not claimed official exact HEX

paintingInputContract.voiceMode: command during drawing; dictation only while a valid text field is focused. Never interpret dictation as a drawing command.
paintingInputContract.commandPolicy: Follow G03: one Smart Voice button, click toggles, hold speaks, release ends recording. Ending recording does not submit or execute. Pure command mode has no composer. Apply only through an explicit app action or confirmed command contract; mixed toggle/hold details remain unresolved. Cancel stale targets and never replay unknown results.
paintingInputContract.dock: Default shared two-row input dock, 390x136 at y708; retain tools, keyboard/pointing entries and their positions. Label is 智慧语音 in all scenes. No painting-specific rearrangement.
paintingInputContract.draftPolicy: Text remains on the original synchronized target after blur. Unknown focus protects unconfirmed input and blocks writes. Late transcripts never become commands or enter another target.

rules: Visible background transmission and fine bright edges
One shared editing-toolbar base, no repeated button backing plates
Application theme independent from content color
Preserve black-blue painting and matte game exceptions

textEditingContract.editResult: Explicit polish updates the bound text or valid selection directly; undo is available.
textEditingContract.objectInstructions: Submit explicitly from the sole composer; detailed results remain on PC. No phone before/after or Apply step.

captureIconContract.visual: Monitor outline with capture corners; never reuse SelectAll geometry

auxiliaryLifecycle.spaceRule: Hide the auxiliary module and expand the sole composer; fixed dock stays stable.
auxiliaryLifecycle.prototypeBoundary: Figma visibility variables simulate the current example; runtime state must be scoped by app/task/target/input revision/intent.
auxiliaryLifecycle.recognitionResult: Create/update a large icon-led intent chip inside the sole composer.
auxiliaryLifecycle.confirmationPolicy: Only where adoption is required; no extra Done for live color/HEX or direct formatting. Confirm adopts local input, never sends or executes.
auxiliaryLifecycle.actionArea: Keep actions outside scrollable/drawing content; reserve bottom-right space without overlapping the fixed dock.

intentChipContract.placement: inside sole composer, in text flow; no permanent toolbar shortcut
intentChipContract.onClose: retain chip and current values; return to Available
intentChipContract.valuePresentation: Recognized value preview + concise action; color uses current swatch + 调整颜色.
intentChipContract.colorBinding: One structured parameter owns swatch and picker/HEX editor; preserve original text, never append generated HEX annotations.

materialInputContract.adoption: Explicit adoption links material to the same task; never submits or approves. Live color parameters retain immediate update semantics.
materialInputContract.send: Submission is explicit and independent. Transfer completion does not prove target readability.
materialInputContract.recovery: Keep text on cancel/error; reject cross-target adoption; retry/remove/choose alternative according to adapter capability. Existing native camera pending sessions and capture-buffer invalidation keep distinct lifecycles.
materialInputContract.geometry: Close top-right and adoption bottom-right; minimum 48x48; actions outside scroll/crop region.
